about: RUN.world 3D batch 1 (owner go-ahead 2026-10-10). Each asset: one clean source image made from its approved S6 concept panel, then Hunyuan image-to-3D, then the local slim and bake. Moving parts are separate assets (wheels, the print head, the crawler arm, the press ram, the projector head). Sizes are metres along `axis`. Structural lattice pieces (walls, floors, roofs) stay procedural: they must tile exactly. Runtime effects (pixel plumes, beams, lamp glow) are not modelled.

budgets.about: Triangles per level [low, mid, high]. low = S1-S2 (flat shaded, 256 px maps), mid = S3-S4 (smooth by angle 30 deg + baked normals, 512), high = S5-S6 (the same, 1024). Auto picks the level from the Graphics setting, like Astro. Low stays at a quarter or more of high for anything with thin parts: the scout cage shattered at 1.4k. Structures stay lean because a base holds hundreds of them.

notes: 2026-10-10 owner: "the roll cage will need to be built by hand or the shape needs to be more chunky, that thos buggys wont work". The scout body and wheel are re-prompted chunky (thick square bars, solid panels, a disc rim with cut-outs). Thin tubes and wire spokes do not survive generation or decimation; avoid them in every prompt.

2026-10-10 owner: "add the building pieces and other 3d stuff like lab pieces to the pipeline, might as well have it all match"; "the lab design is not final so feel free to make it nice as you can and have it match"; "the layout, it can all change if you feel there is a more AAA presentation". Structure assets carry `box`, the procedural kit piece bounds at S6 (lattice frame): the post step fits each to its box exactly and snaps edge vertices flush so neighbours meet. Lab pieces take the base kit family style.

2026-10-10 owner: "the undersides of the trucks are all tubing, the models can have tubing but inset into something solid, cover some things with armor if they wont read well". Every prompt now asks for armour plates, skirts and a belly pan over suspension and undercarriage; the vehicle bodies are re-prompted.

2026-10-10 owner: "if there is an option to preserve the uv islands when you reduce the polygons it might help". It found the real cause: the generated mesh arrives in Blender as disconnected UV islands, so Decimate shrank each island alone and the borders pulled apart. scripts/lod-bake.py now welds them (merge by distance) before decimating: no more shards, even on the thin scout at 2.5k.
2026-10-10 owner: "the scout can have a roll cage but built into panels so no more tubes/cages". The scout body is an enclosed panelled cab shell.

Vehicle bodies are re-prompted with empty cabs and empty wheel arches; vehicle-seat and steering-wheel are separate assets placed at each body's seat sockets.
